claims.locator: atlas/FIELD_CONTENT_CONVENTIONS.md, explicit F_SM/R_SM/R_MSSM templates; source model-definition locator below
claims.value: Expand the expressly inherited SM/MSSM with its standard three families and exact representations. Dynkin maps: su(3) 3=[1,0], anti-3=[0,1], adjoint=[1,1]; su(2) d has label [d-1]. All Weyl fields are LH, including u^c,d^c,e^c. Ordinary textbook Y is used only as the declared baseline coordinate, not claimed to be individually tabulated by this source. No right-handed neutrino or additional sector is invented.

claims.value: SM Lagrangian plus a single new real scalar S, completely neutral under SM gauge group and the only new electroweak-scale degree of freedom. Higgs H is the SM Higgs doublet. This fixes one real (Lorentz scalar, gauge singlet), not one complex singlet.

claims.locator: Section 2, PDF pp.5-6 / printed pp.4-5, Eqs.(2.1)-(2.2)
claims.value: Potential contains real-singlet mass, quartic and portal with coefficient lambda S^2 H^dagger H; S -> -S imposed. These interaction choices do not alter the gauge/matter row.
Inherited textbook hypercharge baseline normalizes jointly by 6; the new scalar has exactly zero charge. This is an atlas baseline coordinate, not a new source hypercharge table.
